input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Brand New Me"?

documents.text: A Brand New Me (Dusty Springfield album) A Brand New Me is the sixth studio album by English singer Dusty Springfield, released on Atlantic Records in January 1970. The album was also released in the UK three months later on Philips Records, under the title "From Dusty with Love". The album was recorded in late 1969 at the Sigma Sound Studios in Philadelphia. It is Springfield's only album on which every song was produced by the same production team: Kenny Gamble and Leon Huff.
